controls.build: development; same bundler/runtime/dependencies for paired source replay; record exact versions; no dependency installation or historical source rewrite
controls.seed: use existing pinned test composition seed; record both branch fingerprints and exact semantic input; no regeneration to seek PASS
controls.fonts: record loaded families and font-file hashes; wait document.fonts.ready and settled style/layout; retain SSR/first-client observations separately; failed readiness is not product geometry PASS
controls.externalConfiguration: public test Turnstile key only, all form submissions intercepted with controlled responses; no real delivery, secrets, registrations or token logging
controls.projectionComparison: common explicit mode lane plus separate actual policy-selected runtime lane; never equate different actual modes
controls.historicalLimit: frozen source under current installed toolchain, not recreated historical browser installation or historical aggregate PASS
controls.scopeChanges: OUT_OF_AUDIT_SCOPE / NEEDS_REVIEW: record available evidence for owner decision; no automatic expansion or new broad investigation; no product/runtime repairs.
controls.collectionFailure: continue independent declared slots; missing observations remain UNCLASSIFIED; at most two bounded diagnostic collector corrections per unresolved root, no speculative third attempt
controls.providerInputLock: Before a paired observation, persist the exact controlled script/callback/API/occupied-widget input. Metadata population within an approved slot is permitted; adding slot/profile/state is not. Unknown supported maxima remain UNCLASSIFIED.
controls.toolchainInputLock: Record installed Node, package manager, Next, Playwright and engine versions plus both lockfile hashes before collection; match bundler/runtime for paired source replay. Do not install dependencies or invent historical equivalence.

accessEnvelope.transientStateRule: VALIDATING may not commit visibly; record that and preserve exact source/state envelope obligation; do not manufacture live-frame evidence
accessEnvelope.providerRule: pin concrete callback/script/API fixture and provider geometry metadata before each pair. A mocked 44px container cannot prove a real interactive maximum. Failed/uncontrolled live interaction is UNCLASSIFIED, not PASS. At most one initial plus one explained diagnostic retry per engine/source/profile provider slot; no unbounded challenge loop.
accessEnvelope.emailInputs: empty and 254-character input at IDLE; fixed valid synthetic test input for API outcomes; never persist real personal data
accessEnvelope.focusSamples: email, checkbox, privacy link, submit and status; focus outlines measured in IDLE and failure/success states with the existing controls, no clone markup

sequence: Mount; capture SSR/first-client equality before post-hydration response, then readiness and baseline counters.
Visit all 13 scenes in canonical traversal; inspect complete content/ink/overflow and semantic branch order.

At Services, How It Works and each Projects card: declared pointer/touch action, keyboard focus, selection, Escape/dismissal where the existing control supports it, restore idle; retain intermediate and settled envelopes.
At Access: email/consent/privacy/submit/status focus order; controlled failure and success; no provider transmission.
Header navigate forward/backward; user-input interruption, active location, browser Back/Forward, restore starting scene; static uses native navigation only.
Resize width +64 CSS px, restore original dimensions; repeat existing rebuild once only when mode owns one; inspect rest geometry, generation stability and cleanup.
Hide and resume once; leave and return once; inspect listener/observer/frame/probe cleanup and restored canonical geometry, with actual visibility provenance.
lifecycle.notes: assertions apply to owned mode behavior; do not demand a timeline in reduced/static; unsupported controls recorded with contract justification, never blanket skip. No successor Stage-2+ motion implementation.

sequence: Load root route in the declared JS/media state.
Traverse all 13 scene contents using native vertical scroll in Professional-first order.
Check headings, complete text, ink where required, X/Y overflow, form/CTA reachability and contact/Access availability.
With JS enabled, exercise keyboard/status focus under forced colors using mocked form outcomes; with JS disabled, verify the actual no-JS contract without inventing token/submission support.
Record inaccessible/unsupported critical actions and cleanup truthfully; no real mail or external form submission.

completion.stopAt: STOP after ONE deduplicated batch inventory for owner/governance disposition; do not begin repairs. No direct audit-to-Sol continuation.

counts.overlapReuse: same-input observations may be referenced across groups; all slots retain evidence references

executionEfficiency.collection: automated batched observation matrix, not independent model tasks
executionEfficiency.persistence: raw structured current/frozen measurements keyed by manifest slot; retain PASS data on disk
executionEfficiency.comparison: automatic equivalent-input join and delta extraction, retain raw failures and unmatched/unknown inputs
executionEfficiency.grouping: mechanical occurrence grouping followed by evidence-based ROOT CAUSE deduplication; equal symptoms alone do not prove shared roots
executionEfficiency.humanReport: one deduplicated batch inventory and occurrence matrices; summarize passing groups by count and fingerprints
forbidden: per-observation narrative analysis for thousands of slots
reproducing identical passing observations in model context
skipping failures to reduce reporting cost

screenshots.existingCanonicalArtifactException: Retain an explicitly required artifact and cite its contract; a test screenshot side effect alone is not a new per-slot mandate. Original tests/thresholds remain unchanged; audit collectors preserve assertion evidence.
screenshots.laterHumanGeometryApproval: separate later acceptance captures after repair/qualification; not this audit

observationRecordContract.groupingRule: preserve per-slot results on disk; root signature includes causal owner/mechanism and equivalent-input evidence, not only rounded geometry or identical error text
observationRecordContract.unobservedRule: never PASS; all required gaps block evidence qualification
observationRecordContract.outsideRule: separate incident list; does not change expected slot count

coverageFingerprint.algorithm: sha256 sorted compact JSON of named coverage sections
coverageFingerprint.rule: Must equal the approved proposed coverage; execution efficiency changes collection/reporting, not slot coverage.
